dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About your research?

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: Why do I research ancient ruins? Out of curiosity, naturally! Surely you find the tantalizing traces of history inside irresistible too?

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: Reading The Mondstadt Tower was what first got me interested in history.

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: Everyone describes it as a historical romance, but... Personally, I didn't see what was so romantic about it when I read it.

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: If you've never read it, you should take this copy. Seriously, it's a good read.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you running into some difficulties?

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: Yes... In the interests of his safety, Mr. Doolan seems to think that there is no such thing as being what I would call overcautious.

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: Sometimes the discovery to be made is so valuable that it merits taking on a certain amount of risk... but he sees that view as just an excuse for being rash and impulsive.

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: Neither of us will be persuaded by the other, and he also keeps interrupting me... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He seems like a bit of a shady character.

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: Oh, I wouldn't go that far... Sure, he's not with the Adventurers' Guild, but he's an adventurer all the same.

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: He has much more adventuring experience than me, and as a result he can discern the risks far better than I in many scenarios.

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: I just think it's a bit difficult communicating with him; sometimes I barely understand what's coming out of his mouth... Maybe I'm just being too rigid and inflexible?

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: There must be a better point of entry, there has to be— Oh, sorry. Hello, traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's happened?

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: I am a researcher of ancient ruins. I simply have to find a way to get inside and investigate... But how in the world is one supposed to get past a Ruin Guard?

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: My acquaintance Doolan, an adventurer, was once injured by a Ruin Guard when he, too, sought to venture inside these ruins. We are discussing how to approach it.

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: *sigh* But after hours and hours of discussion, we have made no progress whatsoever...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: Okay, bye. I'll keep mulling this over...
